what_html:
Two unofficial guide sections share this domain. The Football Manager 27 section covers mods, skins, logo packs, player databases, tactics and the release timeline. The Sephiria section covers Hard Mode, the Destiny Inscription tree, builds, weapons, bosses and co-op.

Both are written by one person and checked against the publisher's own pages, Steam posts and dated community guides. Pages that depend on a game build say which build they describe, and a page that cannot settle a question says so rather than filling the gap. Files are never hosted here: mod, skin and pack pages link to the maintainer's own download page, because that is where the current version and installation notes live.
